say:0:1631604001:0.text: Are you... Merlin?! How come there are two of you?!
say:0:1631604001:0.source_cn: 您……居然是梅林？！两个梅林？！
say:0:1631604001:0.male: Are you... Merlin?! How come there are two of you?!
say:0:1631604001:0.female: Are you... Merlin?! How come there are two of you?!

say:1:1631604002:0.source_cn: 管家竟然没有向您汇报？

say:0:1631605001:0.text: About a year ago... or maybe two...
say:0:1631605001:0.source_cn: 大概……一年前？还是两年前？
say:0:1631605001:0.male: About a year ago... or maybe two...
say:0:1631605001:0.female: About a year ago... or maybe two...

say:1:1631605002:0.text: Someone who looks exactly like you showed up!
say:1:1631605002:0.source_cn: 这座塔里，来了一位和您一样的人！
say:1:1631605002:0.male: Someone who looks exactly like you showed up!
say:1:1631605002:0.female: Someone who looks exactly like you showed up!

say:0:1631606001:0.text: I saw the person myself! Shush... I think he's right upstairs.
say:0:1631606001:0.source_cn: 我亲眼所见！嘘……他应该还在楼上。
say:0:1631606001:0.male: I saw the person myself! Shush... I think he's right upstairs.
say:0:1631606001:0.female: I saw the person myself! Shush... I think she's right upstairs.

say:1:1631606002:0.text: Let me bring you to him!
say:1:1631606002:0.male: Let me bring you to him!
say:1:1631606002:0.female: Let me bring you to her!

say:0:1631609001:0.text: Close call! Good thing I had the upper hand...
say:0:1631609001:0.source_cn: 差点上当，还好我技高一筹……
say:0:1631609001:0.male: Close call! Good thing I had the upper hand...
say:0:1631609001:0.female: Close call! Good thing I had the upper hand...
